class: Authentication snapshot and DOM scope mismatch
symptom: After opening Sign In over the registration page, the cloud run still reported an unresolved account-creation attempt and did not sign in.
root_cause: The snapshot was scoped to the active dialog, but _password_boxes counted visible password inputs across the whole page and all frames. Two background registration passwords plus the modal password classified the sign-in dialog as CREATE_FORM. The browser auth helper also gave the adapter background registration state priority over an existing sign-in form.
why_tests_missed: Account state tests supplied isolated snapshots or forms; none combined a sign-in dialog with visible registration controls and background password frames.
fix: Count password inputs in the same active dialog as the snapshot. Include only embedded frames belonging to that dialog, while preserving whole-page frame counting when no dialog is open. Prioritize an explicit single-password sign-in form over background registration, preserve verification requirements, and disable registration fallback for that sign-in action.
prevention: Test authentication perception against overlapping real browser forms, and keep DOM-derived field counts in the same interaction scope as accessibility-derived headings and controls.
